headline: Germany and Nigeria Explore Investment and Energy Cooperation Partnerships
summary: A delegation of German parliamentarians visited Nigeria to explore new opportunities for bilateral investment, energy cooperation, and technical skills development.
why: Germany has actively sought expanded natural gas and clean energy supply partnerships across Africa to diversify European energy imports.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Bilateral talks explore expanding German industrial investment and energy cooperation in Nigeria.
